name: AD_ORDER_DIGITAL_TYPE
description: This code is a classification of online channels for advertisements.  Examples: - Web - Interactive television - Interactive game play device

name: AD_ORDER_EVENT

description: This entity is used for future estimates, projections, and forecasts of ad order expenses by ad space buyers. description: This entity captures header information regarding an advertisement order from a buyer (advertiser or ad agency) to an ad space seller (ad agency or publisher) indicating the buyer's desire to reserve space to display an advertisement.

name: AD_ORDER_HEADER_DETAIL

name: AD_ORDER_HEADER_PLATFORM_XREF
description: This entity links ad orders to the platforms (channel instances) they are associated with.

name: AD_ORDER_HEADER_SUBTYPE

name: AD_ORDER_LINE_CATEGORY
description: This entity captures information regarding categories of ad order lines.

name: AD_ORDER_LINE_DETAIL

name: AD_ORDER_LINE_TYPE

name: AD_ORDER_MAKE_GOOD_REASON_TYPE

name: AD_ORDER_MAKE_GOOD_REFUND
description: This entity captures information regarding a make good request for a refund. The customer refuses to accept a replacement and requests a refund of the order.

name: AD_ORDER_MAKE_GOOD_SUBTYPE
description: This entity defines ad order make good subtypes such as placement and refund.

description: This entity defines the status of an ad order header over time.

name: AD_ORDER_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity defines the status of an ad order.  Examples: - Canceled - On hold - Complete

name: AD_ORDER_TRADITIONAL_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding traditional channels for advertisements.  Examples: - Print - Television - Billboard - Radio

name: AD_ORDER_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the type of ad order.  Examples: - Normal - Per inquiry - Political - Sports - Direct response

name: AD_PERFORMANCE_RATING
description: This entity captures information regarding the standardized viewership ratings for ads. In the USA, this would typically be the VNU/Nielsen rating.

name: AD_PERFORMANCE_RATING_DAYPART
description: This entity captures information regarding the standardized viewership ratings for ads. In the USA, this would typically be the VNU/Nielsen rating; the information is stored relative to the specific day part it is associated with.

name: AD_PLACEMENT
description: This is the placement request and delivery as specified by the ad order.  Examples: Traditional: - Totally solar ad on page 17 of March 2008 Wired magazine - Garden gnome ad on page 78 of House and Gardens magazine  Digital: - Dell student special ad in banner space of AOL.com - Norton antivirus ad

name: AD_PLACEMENT_BROADCAST_PLATFORM
description: This captures information regarding broadcast output platform (channel instance) for this ad order.  Examples: - TV - Radio

name: AD_PLACEMENT_DISPLAY_TIME
description: This entity defines the date and time that an ad was shown.  Examples: - Ad 2005467 is shown Monday morning (9am-11am) - Ad 872364098 is shown on Weekends (24 hours a day)

name: AD_PLACEMENT_OUTDOOR_PLATFORM
description: This entity captures information regarding the display medium for outdoor advertisement placement. The outdoor medium covers billboards and advertisement displayed on vehicles.

name: AD_PLACEMENT_PRINT_PLATFORM
description: This entity captures information regarding the display medium for the advertisement placement. The print medium covers display mediums such as books, magazines, newspapers, and yellow pages.

name: AD_PLACEMENT_SUBTYPE
description: This code identifies the medium in which the ad appeared and is used as a category discriminator such as: - Print - TV - Radio - Web - Email

name: AD_RATING
description: This entity captures information regarding a specific rating (or certification) that can be assigned to an ad for an audience type or age.

name: AD_RATING_REASON
description: This entity provides the reason a certain ad rating is assigned.  Note: A recursive structure can be added if a hierarchy (or subdivisions) of reasons are required.  Examples: - Adult Themes - Strong Language - Sexual Content - Violence

name: AD_RATING_REASON_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding all the reasons a specific rating code of a specific rating system was assigned to an ad.

name: AD_RATING_SYSTEM
description: This entity captures information regarding a rating (or certification) system devised to rate advertisements for an audience type or age.

name: AD_RATING_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding a specific rating (or certification) that has been assigned to an ad for an audience type or age.

name: AD_RELATED
description: This entity captures information that allows two related ads to be linked.  Note: Use this structure if a many-to-many relationship is desired between ads.

name: AD_RELATED_TYPE
description: This entity captures information that specifies why two ads are related.

name: AD_SPONSORSHIP_CATEGORY_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding ad sponsorship categories.  Examples: - NBA - MLB - NFL - NHL - NASCAR - Music - Hollywood - Skiing - Surfing - Extreme sports - Other - None

name: AD_SPONSORSHIP_PROGRAM_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding ad sponsorship programs.  Examples: - NFL Playoffs - NFL Super Bowl - NFL Kickoff - NASCAR Daytona - March Madness - Ski championship - Olympics - Surf extravaganza - Surf Australia competition - Extreme sports battle

name: AD_SPOT
description: This entity captures information that defines a type of media space that can be sold by a media publisher. name: AD_SPOT_GROUP
description: This is a grouping of ad spots.

name: AD_SPOT_GROUP_XREF
description: This provides for an ad to be in many groups and a group to contain many ads.

name: AD_SPOT_PLACEMENT_XREF
description: This entity links ads to their requested placement spots.

name: AD_STATUS
description: This entity defines the status of an ad over time.

name: AD_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity defines the status of an ad.  Examples: - Active - Canceled - Under trial test

name: AD_SUBCATEGORY
description: This code provides a second higher level of classification of advertisement.

name: AD_SUBTYPE
description: This is a classification of advertisement delivery types such as radio, TV, and web.

name: AD_TRACKING_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the code assigned by the ad delivery system to enable tracking of ads.

name: AD_TRAIT
description: This entity captures information regarding the actual value describing the specific trait of a specific ad. An ad can have an unlimited number of ad traits.

name: CALENDAR_SPREAD_OPTION
description: A calendar spread option is similar to an ordinary spread option except the price differential is between two forward or futures contracts with different maturities on the same underlying asset.

name: CAMPAIGN
description: A campaign is a concentrated effort to retain, acquire, or consolidate customers or to build an image. It has a specific start and end date and typically consist of multiple promotions. name: CAMPAIGN_AUDIENCE_REACH_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the type of audience the campaign will be targeted toward.  Examples: - Local - Regional - National - International

name: CAMPAIGN_CELL

description: The advertisements used by a campaign cell.

name: CAMPAIGN_CELL_CLASSIFICATION

name: CAMPAIGN_CELL_COST

name: CAMPAIGN_CELL_MANAGEMENT

name: CAMPAIGN_CELL_RESPONSE

name: CAMPAIGN_CELL_WEB_SITE_SECTION

name: CAMPAIGN_CLASSIFICATION

name: CAMPAIGN_CONDITION
description: This associative entity identifies the key conditions that are highlighted about this product during this campaign.

name: CAMPAIGN_COST
description: A summary of costs for a specific time period, by the type of cost.  Cost associated with a specific marketing campaign.

name: CAMPAIGN_COST_CATEGORY
description: This entity describes a high-level of grouping of campaign costs.  Examples: - Utilities - Operations - Staffing - Supplies - Advertising - Third-party - Material - Capital Acquisition

name: CAMPAIGN_COST_TYPE
description: This entity describes the types of costs that can be incurred for a campaign.  Examples - Mailing - Staffing - Print costs - Marketing consulting - Research - Material - Distribution

name: CAMPAIGN_INTEREST_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding this campaign's placement areas of interest.  Examples: - Magazine - Newspaper - Cable TV - Radio - Outdoor - Conference - Event - Email marketing - Web - Research - General

name: CAMPAIGN_LEVEL_TYPE

description: This entity contains a history of the roles (as specified by the attribute Campaign Party Role Cd) that a party plays in the management and running of a campaign.

name: CAMPAIGN_MEDIA_MIX_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the media mix utilized by a campaign.  Examples: - Print - Digital - Broadcast - Mixed

description: This entity captures information regarding the campaign objective category placement for the ad.  Examples: - Apparel - Baby - Beauty - Business - Family activity - Fashion/trends/celebrity - Food - Health - Home - Lifestyle - Technology - No position

description: This entity captures information regarding the research source for this campaign objective.  Examples: - MRI - MRR

description: This entity captures information regarding a campaign objective unit size. name: CAMPAIGN_STATUS

name: CAMPAIGN_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity defines the status of a campaign.  Examples: - Active - Canceled - Under trial test

name: CAMPAIGN_STEP
description: This entity captures information regarding the phases processed during a campaign.  Examples: - Awareness/reputation - Demand generation - Sales enablement

name: CAMPAIGN_STEP_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the phases that may be proceeded through during a campaign.  Examples: - Awareness/reputation - Demand generation - Sales enablement

name: CAMPAIGN_STRATEGY_TYPE
description: The business objective or strategy of the campaign.  Example: - Increase sales of snowmobiles in America that are east of the Rocky Mountains. - Prevent fraudulent charges

name: CAMPAIGN_TARGET_MARKET
description: This entity captures information regarding the geography designations included in a specific campaign cell.  Note: This structure would be especially useful for indirect marketing campaigns.

name: CAMPAIGN_TRAIT
description: These are traits related to a campaign.

name: CAMPAIGN_TRAIT_VALUE
description: This is the set of possible values for a campaign trait.

name: CAMPAIGN_TRAIT_VALUE_XREF
description: This relates the campaign trait value of a given trait to a given campaign.

name: CAMPAIGN_TYPE
description: The types of campaigns that can be conducted by the organization. description: This is a type of campaign that is a concerted effort to expand the third-party network business. This effort includes acquiring more credit card merchants, partnering with card issuers, encouraging merchant promotion of card acceptance at their location, or reciprocating network acceptance.

name: CLAIM_PROVIDER_SURVEY_RESPONSE
description: This entity contains the survey results about a provider to a claim.

name: CLAIM_SURVEY_RESPONSE
description: This subentity identifies the claim that is the subject of this survey question.

description: COLLECTION CAMPAIGN is a concentrated effort to collect payment on delinquent accounts in order to bring them current. description: This entity captures information regarding an offer (or offers) made to a customer as compensation for feedback received. name: CONSUMER_MARKETING_CAMPAIGN
description: This is a type of CAMPAIGN related to the credit card and consumer product business. An acquisition campaign focuses on acquiring new customers for cards, banking products or other consumer products. A portfolio campaign focuses on existing customers for retention, increased usage or cross-sell.

name: DOWNLOAD_EVENT
description: This entity captures information regarding download events.

name: DOWNLOAD_FAILURE_REASON_TYPE
description: This is a code for the description of why a download failed.  Examples: - Link failed - User disconnected unexpectedly - Server failed

name: DOWNLOAD_ITEM
description: This entity captures information regarding items that are downloaded from the web site.

description: This entity identifies the event that is the subject of the survey. For example, the survey may ask for feedback about a recent phone call event.

name: KEYWORD_PLACEMENT_AD_GROUP_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding linkages between paid search keywords and paid search ad groups. Ad groups are actually groups of items that have linkages to the keywords or phrases.

name: LEAD_STATUS
description: This entity contains the history of the status of the lead.  Examples: - In nurturing - Marketing qualified - Marketing re-engaged - New - Opportunity accepted - Sales accepted - Sales qualified - Sales re-engaged - Working to sales qualified

name: LEAD_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding status types for leads.  Examples: - In nurturing - Marketing qualified - Marketing re-engaged - New - Opportunity accepted - Sales accepted - Sales qualified - Sales re-engaged - Working to sales qualified

name: LEAD_STEP
description: This entity captures information regarding the routing path for the lead. This designates the sales paths that leads with be routed to.

name: LEAD_STEP_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of step that a lead goes through such as qualification, education, finalization, and cancelation.

name: LEAD_TEXT_COMMENT
description: This entity captures information regarding textual notes concerning a lead.

name: LEAD_TRAIT
description: This entity contains only those traits that are relevant to leads.

name: LEAD_TRAIT_VALUE
description: This entity contains the possible values for lead traits such as first-time home buyer.

name: LEAD_TRAIT_VALUE_XREF
description: This entity associates the lead trait value with the lead.

name: LOYALTY_CONVERSION
description: Calculation factor used to determine the unit equivalence of units in one program with that of another program or within the same program.

name: LOYALTY_LEVEL
description: The domain of achievement ratings that may be associated with the reward benefits level.  Examples: - B: Bronze - S: Silver - G: Gold

name: LOYALTY_LEVEL_QUALIFYING_UNIT
description: This is used to define a relationship between a program loyalty level, the loyalty units that are eligible toward that level and the number of units needed to qualify for a given loyalty level.

name: LOYALTY_PROGRAM
description: This is the domain of programs for tracking and logging rewards and reward packages such as credit card usage rewards.  It is a type of product offered by the financial institution with its own set of terms and conditions and for which an account is set up once joined.

name: LOYALTY_PROGRAM_UNIT
description: This represents a loyalty unit that is assigned to a loyalty program.

name: LOYALTY_UNIT
description: This is a user-defined loyalty unit that, when accumulated, may be used to qualify for higher status levels within a loyalty program or special offers and may be used as a form of exchange for loyalty awards and purchases. Examples might be dollars spent, number of accounts, or longevity as a custom

name: LOYALTY_UNIT_TYPE
description: This is a user-defined type used to further categorize a loyalty unit. For example, types might be used to identify loyalty units that are used for a promotion only, a specific bonus, to distinguish between regional and international distances flown or dollars spent internally versus with a partner

name: MASS_PROMOTION
description: This is a subtype entity to PROMOTION. A lowest level campaign may be a mass promotion. A mass promotion is directed towards a group of people. This entity has no attributes other than the primary key but was created to show the different types of promotions.

name: NEXT_COMMUNICATION
description: This entity contains information about the next communication with this customer such as collecting amounts past due for a given account.

name: NEXT_OFFER
description: This entity contains the next offer to give to this party and the preferred channel instance or channel type.

name: OFFER
description: A specific incentive made available to customers. Usually, contains two parts: a.) condition to be met and b.) the reward for a.). Apply online for equity loan and line of credit and pay no points or opening fees.

name: OFFER_TYPE
description: A classification for the type of offer such as discount offer, free product offer, interest rate offer, and fee waiver offer.

name: OPPORTUNITY
description: An opportunity is the potential for a deal that could be revenue generating for the enterprise.  An opportunity may result in many proposals, which may result in many agreements.  An opportunity can involve many parties with different roles, many products, requirements, issues, and financial informa

name: OPPORTUNITY_ASSET
description: This entity relates assets to the opportunity and allows for more than one asset to be related.  For example, if the opportunity is to finance the lease of an asset then this contains the details of the opportunity for this asset.

name: OPPORTUNITY_ASSET_ROLE_TYPE
description: The role of this asset to this opportunity such as is collateral, is subject of lease, or is subject of insurance.

name: OPPORTUNITY_COMPETITOR
description: This entity contains information about the competitor for this opportunity.  The attributes will vary by type of product or service being proposed. A modeling alternative is to use the Feature entity to specify the various terms and conditions being proposed by the competitor.

name: OPPORTUNITY_COMPETITOR_FINANCE
description: Financial information related to this competitor for this opportunity such as: - Spread rate (for loans) - Fee amount - Funding amount - Commitment amount

name: OPPORTUNITY_COMPETITOR_TEXT
description: Textual notes about the competitor's proposal.

name: OPPORTUNITY_DOCUMENT
description: This entity relates the opportunity to any supporting documents.

name: OPPORTUNITY_DOCUMENT_ROLE_TYPE
description: The role of this document for this opportunity such as "provide ownership title," and "provide claims to."

name: OPPORTUNITY_EVENT
description: This entity relates an opportunity to an event. An opportunity can have many events, but an event is usually for one opportunity. name: OPPORTUNITY_FINANCE
description: This entity contains financial information related to this opportunity such as budgeted sales amount, expected revenue, actual revenue, expected cost, actual cost, and prospect budget.

name: OPPORTUNITY_FINANCE_TYPE
description: The type of metric that is described and can include amounts, rates, or numbers.  Examples: - Spread rate - Funding amount - Term length - Fee amount - Sales budget - Potential revenue - Actual revenue - Potential cost - Actual cost - Customer budget

name: OPPORTUNITY_ISSUE
description: This entity tracks issues related to this opportunity such as: - Cost of product or service - Product availability - Prospect finances - Prospect credit rating - Prospect approval cycle

name: OPPORTUNITY_ISSUE_RESOLVE_TYPE
description: A code for the resolution of this issue such as: - Not resolved - Resolved

name: OPPORTUNITY_ISSUE_TYPE
description: A code for the issues of this opportunity such as: - Cost of product or service - Product availability - Prospect finances - Prospect credit rating - Prospect approval cycle

name: OPPORTUNITY_LEAD_TYPE
description: The source of the lead for this opportunity such as: - Marketing program - Workshop event - Training class - Product promotion - Referral - Personal network

name: OPPORTUNITY_PROMOTION
description: This entity identifies the promotions that have led to the making of this opportunity.

name: OPPORTUNITY_QUOTATION
description: An opportunity can lead to many quotations and a quotation can be the result of many opportunities. This entity provides for this possibility.

name: OPPORTUNITY_REVENUE_SIZE_TYPE
description: This is a code for the revenue size of this opportunity such as: - Unspecified - 250,000 - 500,000 - 500,000 - 1,000,000 - < 250,000 - > 1,000,000

name: OPPORTUNITY_REVENUE_TYPE
description: A code for the revenue type of this opportunity such as: - Unspecified - Pipeline - Upside - Expected - Committed - Closed

name: OPPORTUNITY_SALES_STAGE
description: The stage in the life cycle of the selling process for this opportunity.  Examples: - Received RFP - Planning first call - First call completed - Planning face-to-face meeting - Preparing proposal - Proposal submitted - Decision made

name: OPPORTUNITY_SALES_STAGE_STATUS
description: The status of this sales stage as of a date such as: - Defining - Setting up - In final steps - Completed

name: OPPORTUNITY_SEGMENT
description: This entity relates a market segment to an opportunity for the purpose of tracking over time the marketing related to this segment. Promotions may result from this association.

name: OPPORTUNITY_STATUS
description: The status of this opportunity as of a date such as: - Pending acceptance or rejection - Accepted internally - Rejected internally - Won - Lost - Timed out (too costly in sales stage)

name: OPPORTUNITY_STATUS_REASON
description: The reason(s) this opportunity was won or lost or changed status.  Examples: - Incorrect lead - Prospect financials - No sales budget - Lead not qualified - Good lead - Competition won - Lower price - Location - Product  This entity allows for more than one reason to be entered for this opportunity.

name: OPPORTUNITY_STATUS_REASON_TYPE
description: The reason why a campaign opportunity has a given status such as the reason it was won or lost.  Examples: - Incorrect lead - Prospect financials - No sales budget - Lead not qualified - Good lead - Competition won - Lower price - Location - Product

name: OPPORTUNITY_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code for the status of this opportunity such as: - Pending acceptance or rejection - Accepted internally - Rejected internally - Won - Lost

name: OPPORTUNITY_STEP
description: This entity captures information regarding an action to be taken during an opportunity; each step is one action that could be taken.  Examples: - Send letter 1 via mail - Send application form 2 via mail - Send letter 2 via email - Phone call - Open agreement

name: OPPORTUNITY_STEP_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the possible actions that may be taken during an opportunity.  Examples: - Send letter 1 via mail - Send application form 2 via mail - Send letter 2 via email - Phone call - Open agreement

name: OPPORTUNITY_STRATEGIC_VALUE_TYPE
description: A code for the ranking of strategic value of this opportunity such as: - High - Medium - Low

name: OPPORTUNITY_TEXT
description: Any textual notes about this opportunity.

name: OPPORTUNITY_TEXT_SECTION
description: This entity is the link to opportunity text unstructured data.

name: OPPORTUNITY_TEXT_TYPE
description: A code for the type of text for this opportunity such as: - Product or service being offered - Status information - Conversation information

name: OPPORTUNITY_TYPE
description: A classification of the type of opportunity such as loan, lease, deposit, and investment.  This will be customized based on the enterprise offerings that are complex enough to go through the opportunity and proposal process.

name: OPPORTUNITY_VISIBLE_TYPE
description: A code for how visible this opportunity is in the enterprise such as: - Board of directors - Executive management - Middle management - Line of business

name: PAID_SEARCH_PROMOTION_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding paid search promotion status types.  Examples: - Successful - Failed - Incomplete

name: PROMOTION
description: A narrowly defined marketing effort designed for a specific purpose and can be part of a larger campaign. It usually has a specific start and end date. A promotion can contain multiple offers and ads. For example, a promotion is created to drive DVD sales. It consists of two offers (one for free shi

name: PROMOTION_CELL
description: A cell is a specialized treatment strategy for a grouping of parties for campaign promotion purposes. name: PROMOTION_CLASSIFICATION
description: This entity provides information regarding the classifications of promotions.  Examples: - Increase brand awareness - Increase product sales

name: PROMOTION_EXPENSE_TYPE
description: Identifies the type of expenses use in a campaign and/or promotion.  Examples: - Printing - TV spot - Consulting

name: PROMOTION_EXPENSE_XREF
description: Tracks the budgeted and actual expenses for a promotion.

name: PROMOTION_METRIC
description: This entity captures any kind of metric associated with this promotion including results such as number of hits, number of purchases, number of positive responses, number of negative responses, and budget and actual costs.

name: PROMOTION_METRIC_TYPE
description: A code for the type of promotion metric such as number of hits, number of positive responses, number of negative responses, and number of sales.

name: PROMOTION_OFFER
description: A specific incentive made available to customers. Usually, contains two parts: a.) condition(s) to be met, and b.) the reward for a.) It is usually a narrowly defined marketing effort designed for a specific purpose. Can be part of a larger campaign. It has a specific start and end date. A promotion

name: PROMOTION_OFFER_SEGMENT
description: A mapping of a group of market segments to a specific promotion offer. A promotion offer can be made to more than one market segment.  Example: - All customers whose purchase went down over 50% over the last 6 months are offered $20 off their next order.

name: PROMOTION_OFFER_TYPE
description: This is the type of promotion offer such as a product offer or a product feature offer.

name: PROMOTION_PROSPECT
description: This entity contains information about this promotion for this prospect.  For example, a threshold describes how many times this prospect can be offered this promotion before stopping or going to the next step.

name: PROMOTION_RESPONSE_SCORE
description: This associative entity relates a response score with a party for this promotion. A response score is the probability that a party will respond positively to a promotion.

name: PROMOTION_SCRIPTED_MESSAGE_XREF
description: This entity provides for a promotion to have more than one script and for a script to be used by more than one promotion.

name: PROMOTION_SEGMENT
description: A mapping of a group of market segments to a specific promo offer. A promo offer can be made to more than one market segment.  Example: - All customers whose purchase went down over 50% over the last six months are offered $20 off their next order.

name: PROMOTION_STATUS
description: This entity defines the status of a promotion over time.

name: PROMOTION_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the status of the promotion. Examples would be active, under development, on hold after being active, and closed for deletion.

name: PROMOTION_STEP
description: This entity represents an action to be taken during a promotion. Each step is one action that could be taken.  Examples: - Send letter one via mail - Send application form two via mail - Send letter two via email - Phone call - Open agreement

name: PROMOTION_STEP_RESPONSE
description: This entity contains the next step given a response to a promotion step for a cell. The response may be no response in which case the next step is a "timeout" step. If the next step is null then no further action is taken.  These are planned responses to a step.

name: PROMOTION_STEP_TYPE
description: A code for the classification of a step used during a promotion.  Examples: - Send letter - Send application - Follow-up phone call

name: PROMOTION_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes whether the promotion is a mass, micro, or target marketing. Mass marketing is usually radio, television, and newspaper and covers a wide area. Micromarketing targets a smaller audience, usually a geographical area that has certain characteristics. Target marketing refers

name: REWARD_EVENT
description: This entity is a subtype to AGREEMENT EVENT and contains only those events that involve earning and redeeming loyalty points based on usage of an account such as a credit card account.

name: REWARD_EVENT_SUBTYPE
description: This code describes a kind of loyalty account action  Examples: - Loyalty account earning - Loyalty account redemption

name: REWARD_EVENT_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the type of reward event such as initial bonus event, points earning, points redeeming, and reward points transfer.

name: ROAD_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of road. Possible values are highway, motorway, street, and dirt track.

name: SPREAD_OPTION
description: A type of option that derives its value from the difference between the prices of two or more assets. name: SURVEY_COST
description: This entity contains the cost of surveys over time.

name: SURVEY_EVENT
description: This entity associates a survey with events such as the event that issued the survey, the event that is the response to the survey or an event that is a question about the survey.

name: SURVEY_EVENT_REASON_TYPE
description: This is a code for the reason the event is related to the survey such as the event that issued the survey, the event that is the response to the survey, or the event that is a question about the survey.

name: SURVEY_FEEDBACK
description: This is feedback received in a formal, controlled, or structured format, where specific responses are solicited, and responses (typically) are constrained to selecting one of several choices presented.

name: SURVEY_FEEDBACK_SURVEY_RESPONSE
description: This associates survey feedback to a specific survey response.

name: SURVEY_QUESTION_RESPONSE
description: This entity associates a questionnaire question to a response to that question.  By capturing the date and time of the response (if known), the sequence of the survey responses may be reconstructed, and the overall time taken for the survey and time between responses may be calculated.

name: SURVEY_RESOLUTION
description: Captures all the findings or resolutions made in response to a Survey that was conducted.  Examples: - Improve associate training - Improve item quality inspections

name: SURVEY_RESOLUTION_TYPE
description: Defines a Global Quality-related resolution or action taken to resolve or address feedback received as part of a Survey.  Note: This is a global action, as opposed to the contact level resolution entity that captures the response to an individual party's feedback instead.  Examples: - Improve associ

name: SURVEY_RESPONSE
description: This is a unique response to a questionnaire received by the enterprise. It represents the "completed" questionnaire or survey session with answers filled in.  Examples: - An anonymous questionnaire received in a "suggestions" box - A formal face-to-face interview - A web survey taken by a known cus

name: SURVEY_RESPONSE_ANSWER
description: One or more preformed answers to a survey question given by the responding party.  This entity provides for: - Multiple-choice answers to a question (where only a single answer is expected), for example, income range or quality of service rating - "All that apply" answers (where none or many answers

name: SURVEY_RESPONSE_TEXT
description: Records one or more free-form answers to a question.  Examples: - Question: "Explain how we can best win your loyalty."  Response Text: "Always give the best pricing you can" - Question: "Please enter the given names of your children"  Response Text (3 instances): "Sarah," "Janice," and "Luke"

name: SURVEY_RESPONSE_TEXT_SECTION
description: This entity is the link to survey response text unstructured data.

name: SURVEY_SUBJECT_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the subject of the survey question such as employee (party), organization (party), channel, claim, or account.

name: TARGET_PROMOTION
description: This is a subtype entity to PROMOTION. A lowest level campaign may be a target promotion. A target promotion is directed towards individuals based on individual characteristics. This entity has no attributes other than the primary key but was created to show the different types of promotions.

name: TENDER_OFFER
description: An offer to purchase some or all of shareholders' shares in a corporation. The price offered is usually at a premium to the market price.

name: TRAILER_AD_SUBTYPE
description: This entity captures information that provides a classification scheme used to organize trailer ads. The classification can be used to provide summary information about the performance of various trailer ads.  Examples: - Video game - TV show - Book - Concert event - Movie

name: UPLOAD_ITEM
description: This entity captures information regarding items that are uploaded to the web site.

name: VISIT_PROMOTION_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding visitor promotion offers received during their session.

name: WARRANT_OFFER
description: Call options offered exclusively to shareholders.

name: WEB_AD_PLACEMENT_SUMMARY
description: This provides statistics about web ads that are useful in measuring their effectiveness. These values are usually collected by the ad agency.  For example, banner ad 'blue sweater' on mysite.com has 100 impressions and 20 click-throughs over the last month.

name: WEB_AD_PLACEMENT_TEXT
description: This entity contains text associated with a web ad placement such as: - URI Text – the URI of the advertisement, whether that advertisement be a banner displayed on a publisher's page or a web page interposed between a link of interest to a visitor and the target of that link - URI Stem – the URI St

name: WEB_AD_PLACEMENT_TEXT_SECTION
description: This entity is the link to web ad placement text unstructured data.

name: WEB_AD_TYPE
description: A classification scheme used to organize WEB ADs. The classification can be used to provide summary information about the performance of various WEB ADs.  Examples: - Premium banner ad - Discounted banner ad - Keyword related banner ad

name: WEB_CAMPAIGN_EVENT
description: This entity captures information specific to campaign events.

name: WEB_PAGE_AD_VIEW_XREF
description: This entity provides linkage between web pages viewed and the advertisements displayed on those pages.

name: WEB_PAGE_VIEW_AD_SUMMARY
description: This entity captures summary information regarding the advertisements associated with visitor session activities.
